events.title: Inquiry sent, no attachments
events.subject: Sewing Machine Operators - eligibility inquiry from Morocco
events.body:
Dear Decor-Rest Human Resources Team,

Your current Sewing Machine Operators advertisement describes sewing fabric and leather for upholstered furniture. My experience in Moroccan workshops includes leather cutting, hand and machine sewing, assembly, finishing and quality checks. At CST Corp Morocco and Leather Citizen, I worked on leather garments. At Leather Citizen, I also contributed to upholstery work for Jouffre commissions.

I am a Moroccan national living in Morocco, without Canadian residence or work authorization. My current English and French levels are A2.

Is this full-time position still available, and do you consider candidates applying from outside Canada? Could you confirm the actual work location, weekly hours, gross hourly wage and required English level?

If you consider overseas candidates, can Decor-Rest support the employer-side process for a lawful work permit, such as an LMIA, or identify an applicable exemption? I would relocate and start only after the required authorizations and visa are approved.

This is an eligibility inquiry with no attachments. If there is a suitable opportunity and supported route, I can provide my CV and work portfolio through your preferred recruitment channel.

Kind regards,
Mohammed Fadil
mfadil.med@gmail.com
